# third_party/libusb

Vendored copy of libusb-1.0 source from the upstream `libusb` directory.

- **Upstream:** https://github.com/libusb/libusb
- **Version:** 1.0.27
- **Source tarball:** https://github.com/libusb/libusb/releases/download/v1.0.27/libusb-1.0.27.tar.bz2
- **License:** LGPL-2.1 (see `COPYING`)

To update, replace this directory with the `libusb/` subdir from a newer
libusb release tarball, and update the version in `../build.sh`.
